tactics:
induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases i with
    | zero => simp
    | succ i =>
      have e : i + 1 + j = (i + j) + 1 := by omega
      simp only [List.drop_succ_cons, e, List.getElem_cons_succ]
      exact ih i _
induction xs generalizing i <;> cases i <;> simp_all [-List.getElem_drop]
induction xs generalizing i <;> cases i <;> simp_all [-List.getElem_drop, Nat.add_right_comm]
